rules.logic: BIOC(MP-030 Admin Share C$ Mapped Then Executable Copied into Public Music) AND ABIOC(MP-030 Compromised Account Uncommon Administrative Share Access) AND (IOC(file-sha256 from the report on panw_ngfw_threat_raw) OR ABIOC(MP-030 Sliver Recurring Beacon to Rare Domain)) AND BIOC(MP-030 Credential Dump Log KB0722.log Written to Windows Temp) AND BIOC(MP-030 Security Sensor Service Stopped Disabled and Deleted) AND BIOC(MP-030 Mass File Rename to PLAY Extension with Ransom Note Drop) within 3600s on the same src_host (agent_hostname on xdr_data; endpoint_device_name on the NGFW records; on msft_windows_security the share events land on the target host, so the identity leg keys on source_address = the src_host's IP, not host_name) -> one incident naming the compromised account, the Sliver C2 (americajobmail.site / 172.96.137.224) and the EDR-removal-then-impact sequence.
rules.name: Jumpy Pisces to Play Hand-off — Endpoint, Network and Identity Stitch on One Host
